Developer Guide

Welcome to the Deep Research Engine developer guide. This section is for contributors and developers working on the engine.

Project Overview

The Deep Research Engine is a config-driven multi-agent workflow engine that unifies 4 existing projects:

  1. arrow_forwardDeep Research - Multi-agent RAG research
  2. arrow_forwardPDF Summarizer - PDF processing
  3. arrow_forwardmake-llmstxt - Skill generation
  4. arrow_forwardtracer - Telegram ingestion with multimodal support

Key Insight: All 4 projects use the same Ingestion → Drafter ↔ Critic → Neo4j → Synthesis pattern. The engine makes this configurable via YAML.

Architecture

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
Config (YAML) → Engine → LangGraph Workflow
                     ↓
        Ingestion → Drafter ↔ Critic → Neo4j → Synthesis

Core Design Decisions

  1. arrow_forward

    Generic State - 18 fields max (not 50+)

    • arrow_forwardWorkflow-specific data in context dict
    • arrow_forwardSee: src/deep_research_engine/state/types.py
  2. arrow_forward

    Pluggable Storage - Optional backends

    • arrow_forwardPDF: Just Memory
    • arrow_forwardTelegram: Postgres + Neo4j + MongoDB + MinIO
    • arrow_forwardSee: src/deep_research_engine/storage/
  3. arrow_forward

    Worker ABC - Uniform interface

    • arrow_forwardAll workers implement execute(state, config) -> WorkerResult
    • arrow_forwardSee: src/deep_research_engine/workers/base.py
  4. arrow_forward

    Config-Driven - New workflow = new YAML

    • arrow_forwardSee: configs/*.yaml

BaseWorker

class BaseWorker(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def execute(self, state, config) -> WorkerResult:
        """All workers implement this"""
        pass

Implementation Patterns

Graph Execution

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END
from deep_research_engine.state import EngineState

def build_workflow_graph(config):
    graph = StateGraph(EngineState)
    
    graph.add_node("ingestion", ingestion_node)
    graph.add_node("drafter", drafter_node)
    graph.add_node("critic", critic_node)
    graph.add_node("neo4j", neo4j_builder_node)
    graph.add_node("synthesis", synthesis_node)
    
    graph.add_edge(START, "ingestion")
    graph.add_edge("ingestion", "drafter")
    graph.add_edge("drafter", "critic")
    graph.add_conditional_edges(
        "critic",
        route_after_critic,
        {"pass": "neo4j", "revise": "drafter"}
    )
    graph.add_edge("neo4j", "synthesis")
    graph.add_edge("synthesis", END)
    
    return graph.compile()
